notes.title: Weekly update #17
notes.notes:
Dear Furballs,

Every week, I'll post a "Weekly update" to let you know what is going on in the colorful world of VR Furballs. This is the episode 17 :)


ACHIEVEMENTS PATCH

Earlier today, FunkeymonkeyTTR reported that the Achievements were not unlocking properly. The game was actually not guaranteeing the Achievements to be unlocked, and was failing at unlocking a lot of them on the way.

This is now FIXED. All the Achievements the game failed unlocking for you in the past will unlock automatically the next time you start the game.

Thanks again to FunkeymonkeyTTR for reporting it. He actually runs a cool "VR Achievement Hunters" group that you might be interested in:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/vrachievementhunters/discussions/0/1457328927827659700/


ROAD TO 50 REVIEWS

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31473564/ea4b3de247e9310082c907b1117b095612fab0f0.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31473564/d778776654c29d738c022e9968f95910159ee2ec.jpg

    New: Added EULA, so you will most likely have a Steam popup asking you to agree to it the next time you play.
    New: Added Slingshot pull settings, so you can set how far away from each other your Controllers should be to throw a Furball with the Slingshot at its maximum force.
    New: Added Tennis Racket orientation settings, so you can set the orientation of the Tennis Racket when you hold it.
    New: Added Golf Club length settings, so you can set how long the Golf Club should be (it actually scales the whole Golf Club for now).
    New: Added Vibration settings (ranging from 0% to 200% so that you can turn off, diminish or amplify the controllers vibrations).
    New: Added helper indicator to tell the player to turn on the Slingshot and the Gun.
    Improvement: Improved Graphics settings display (now showing a range between 75% and 125% instead of 0% to 100%).
    Improvement: Furballs can now go through your head when they are being thrown by the Slingshot, preventing your head to deflect the Furball.
    Improvement: Allowed to restart the level even earlier than before (as soon as the first Furball left the area you are in).
    Improvement: Improved throwing physics.
    Improvement: Increased Controllers bounciness.
    Bugfix: Fixed Achievements not being unlocked correctly and made sure all the Achievements you should have unlocked before will get unlocked the next time you start the game.
